limitations: PG17 fixture maps extensions.digest SHA-256 to native PostgreSQL sha256 bytea/text wrappers because PGlite0.3.14 does not ship pgcrypto. Phone authorization logic is not stubbed. PG18 companion proof uses real pgcrypto.

The fixture closure digest uses the exact canonical program-digest function on an isolated synthetic catalog. Equality proves this candidate does not change that algorithm's protected fixture surface; the live certificate value is independently checked at integration. It is not the complete canonical schema or live certificate reproduction.
PGlite is PostgreSQL compiled to WASM; no PostgREST, JWT signature verification, production concurrency/load, provider call or physical-device execution occurred.
engine: PostgreSQL 17.5 on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 3.1.74 (1092ec30a3fb1d46b1782ff1b4db5094d3d06ae5), 32-bit
